name: Waterfront Adventure
original_name: ウォーターフロント・アドベンチャー
source:
The hero lost to a mysterious Mr.H. The winner's request is to bring him 10 used panties. Hero takes a sub to Yokohama Expo to try skillfully get panties from the local companies booths.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公输给了神秘的H先生。胜者提出的要求，是让他带回10条穿过的内裤。主人公乘潜艇前往横滨博览会，打算施展手段，从当地企业的展位弄到内裤。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
